svg.title: Require Evidence Before Scaling the Sale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-evidence-led-sales-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Require Evidence Before Scaling the Sale; subtitle: Verify the problem, prove outreach, distinguish pipeline events, and inspect the delivered result.; caption: Tom Gaddis verifies audit findings; Marcus on Carson Reed requires a personal outreach baseline; Aaron Shepherd separates bookings from projections; Aletto checks results.; assumptions note: Tom Gaddis, Marcus on Carson Reed, Aaron Shepherd, and Aletto supply separate operating checks. Their examples do not establish a shared sales conversion rate.; note: Tom Gaddis | Smart AI Operators — Z3ZaxxexqYE at 00:16:04; Marcus on Carson Reed — L1LsEN_iuIc at 00:38:12; Aaron Shepherd | GrowthFlare — RQg5jgraVg8 at 00:19:17; Aletto — IfS3QohXxG8 at 00:21:55.; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the actual business profile confirm the claimed audit gap?; pass next: G2; fail action: Correct the finding before presenting it. Tom Gaddis found existing review responses where Claude had reported none.; gate: G2; question: Has the personal DM process produced Marcus's baseline of two or three appointments weekly?; pass next: G3; fail action: Keep improving the personal process before delegating it to a virtual assistant.; gate: G3; question: Are interested replies, bookings, attended calls, and projected deals recorded separately?; pass next: G4; fail action: Separate counted events from assumptions. Aaron Shepherd counted about 20 bookings; later deal estimates were not counted sales.; gate: G4; question: Does the actual delivered result satisfy the definition of done?; pass next: Accept the inspected result; fail action: Aletto allows up to three repair attempts, then escalates with proof. A success message alone does not establish completion.

text.title: Require Evidence Before Scaling the Sale
text.tspan: Require Evidence Before Scaling the Sale

rect.title: gate: G1; question: Does the actual business profile confirm the claimed audit gap?; pass next: G2; fail action: Correct the finding before presenting it. Tom Gaddis found existing review responses where Claude had reported none.

gate: G2; question: Has the personal DM process produced Marcus's baseline of two or three appointments weekly?; pass next: G3; fail action: Keep improving the personal process before delegating it to a virtual assistant.

gate: G3; question: Are interested replies, bookings, attended calls, and projected deals recorded separately?; pass next: G4; fail action: Separate counted events from assumptions. Aaron Shepherd counted about 20 bookings; later deal estimates were not counted sales.

gate: G4; question: Does the actual delivered result satisfy the definition of done?; pass next: Accept the inspected result; fail action: Aletto allows up to three repair attempts, then escalates with proof. A success message alone does not establish completion.

text.title: Assumptions: Tom Gaddis, Marcus on Carson Reed, Aaron Shepherd, and Aletto supply separate operating checks. Their examples do not establish a shared sales conversion rate.
